status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Neo-brutalism
use_when: Use for bold internal campaigns, creative tools, and memorable learning cards.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Bold system sans-serif headlines with sturdy body type.
layout: Strong boxes, explicit labels, and clear hierarchy.
surfaces: Heavy dark borders, hard offset shadows, bright pastel accents.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Neo-brutalism to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Bold system sans-serif headlines with sturdy body type. Strong boxes, explicit labels, and clear hierarchy. Heavy dark borders, hard offset shadows, bright pastel accents. Palette: background #f3f1e5, surface #fffef7, text #22251f, muted #565c4e, accent #614e94, border #22251f. Essential traits: Hard offset shadow; Thick visible borders; Direct bold typography. Avoid: Decoration that obscures affordance; Uncontrolled visual noise; Color-only controls. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
